correctness.rationale: Let A=k⊕V with V²=0 and n=dimV>=1. Writing P(1)=a+v and P(u)=f(u)+Bu, scalar components of the RB identity at (u,w) force f(u)f(w)=0 hence f=0; at (1,1) force a=0. Vector identities then give B²=0 and 2Bv=0, and conversely these suffice on all pairs. Thus P³=0, P²(1)=Bv. In char!=2 all P²=0; in char2 n=2 permits B(e2)=e1,v=e2, so sharp index3. GL(V) conjugation of squarezero B and marked v yields rank r and strata v=0, nonzero imB, kerB\imB, V\kerB; last char2 only. The centralizer block action is transitive on each nonempty stratum. The q-binomial count R(n,r)=[n r]_q[n-r r]_q|GL_r| follows from image/kernel/isomorphism choices. Exact T_even=q^n sum R and C_index3=sum R(q^n-q^(n-r)) follow; rank concentrated above n/3 as n→∞ for fixed even q, making P²=0 proportion→0. Independent F2 n=2 enumeration gave 4 squarezero B, 16 RB maps, 6 index3. Finite checks support but do not replace all-field orbit/asymptotic proofs.
